LESSON: THE FALL OF MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.3: The Fall of Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Fall of Man. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Fall of Man using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Fall of Man in the examples.
2. Explain The Fall of Man to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Fall of Man.
4. Show that you can: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Fall of Man using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Fall of Man important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Genesis 3:1-11 in turns and explain the fall of man,
2. Discuss lessons learnt from the fall of man (Adam and Eve),

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
